headline: Borr Drilling Reaffirms Five Missing After Rig Sinking
deck: The company says 110 of 115 people aboard Prospector 5 are safe and accounted for; those accounted for are being brought ashore in Gabon.
body: Since the paper’s 25 October coverage, Borr Drilling has said the 110 people it had accounted for are being brought ashore in Gabon for care and support; the company still says five of 115 people aboard remain unaccounted for. [E1][E2][E6]
Baird Maritime reported that Borr’s preliminary account said the rig punched through during preload, lost stability and sank. [E4]
Borr Drilling said its emergency-response team is working with local authorities and its customer while extensive marine and air search-and-rescue operations continue. [E3]
Borr Drilling said it is working with partners and authorities on an investigation into the incident while the search remains its immediate priority. [E5]
